title: JEPA as a Transferable Optimizer: Learning and Understanding Black-Box Optimization from Reward-Agnostic Pretraining
abstract: arXiv:2611.23608v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Black-box optimization evaluates candidates through simulations, rollouts, or experiments, often without gradients. Learned optimizers are usually judged by whether they outperform existing methods. We ask a complementary question: what information does a learned optimizer use from its search history? We introduce JEPA-PS (JEPA Policy Search), based on a Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture. It is pretrained on random rollouts using parameter vectors and scalar returns. Its latent-prediction objective predicts the next point in an optimization trajectory rather than its reward or gradient, allowing us to examine what was tried and how well it performed. At test time, JEPA-PS reads a short evaluation history and proposes a candidate in one forward pass, without task descriptions, reward shaping, or test-time gradients. translated_title: JEPA作为可迁移的优化器：从奖励无关的预训练中学习与理解黑盒优化
translated_abstract: 黑盒优化通过仿真、轨迹采样或实验来评估候选解，通常无法获得梯度。学习型优化器通常以是否优于现有方法来评判。我们提出了一个互补的问题：学习型优化器从其搜索历史中究竟使用了什么信息？我们提出了基于联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）的JEPA-PS（JEPA策略搜索）。它以参数向量和标量回报为输入，在随机轨迹上进行预训练。其潜空间预测目标预测的是优化轨迹中的下一个点，而非其奖励或梯度，这使我们能够考察“尝试了什么”以及“表现如何”。在测试时，JEPA-PS读取一段简短的评估历史，仅需一次前向传播即可提出候选解，无需任务描述、奖励塑形或测试时的梯度。我们在15个控制环境中与12种优化器进行了对比评估，其中包括进化方法和贝叶斯优化等方法。
tldr: 提出了基于联合嵌入预测架构的学习型优化器JEPA-PS，通过奖励无关的预训练学习预测优化轨迹中的下一个点而非奖励本身，测试时仅需一次前向传播即可提出候选解，并在15个控制环境中与12种优化器对比验证了其性能，同时增强了对优化器如何利用搜索历史的可解释性。
en_tdlr: Proposes JEPA-PS, a learned black-box optimizer built on a Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture that is pretrained reward-agnostically to predict the next point in an optimization trajectory rather than rewards, enabling candidate generation in a single forward pass at test time and revealing what information optimizers actually use from their search history.
